description: This file defines the internal class StatelessWorkerGrainContext, which manages stateless worker grains in the Orleans runtime. It handles message processing, worker lifecycle, idle worker removal, and related internal mechanisms.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerGrainContext
classes.description: Manages stateless worker grains, including message processing, worker lifecycle, and idle worker removal strategies within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RunMessageLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing work items for the stateless worker, handling messages, deactivation, disposal, and idle worker collection.

methods.name: CollectIdleWorkers
methods.description: Implements control logic to detect and deactivate idle workers based on a PID controller algorithm.

methods.name: ReceiveMessageInternal
methods.description: Handles incoming messages by assigning them to workers, creating new workers if necessary.

methods.name: CreateWorker
methods.description: Creates a new worker activation, activates it, and adds it to the worker list.

methods.name: DeactivateInternal
methods.description: Deactivates all workers managed by this context.

methods.name: DeactivatedTaskInternal
methods.description: Completes the deactivation process for all workers and signals completion.

methods.name: DisposeAsyncInternal
methods.description: Disposes of resources asynchronously, including timers and worker activations.
